high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "timberandgray." The post features a decorative sign placed on a windowsill. The sign has a rustic wooden frame and a white background with black cursive text that reads, "THE DAYS ARE LONG BUT THE YEARS ARE SHORT." The sign is positioned in front of a window with blinds partially open, allowing natural light to illuminate the scene. Behind the sign, there is a green plant with broad leaves, adding a touch of nature to the composition. The windowsill appears to be part of a cozy indoor setting, possibly a home or a small shop.
